claude.sample_unit: patients with abnormal FIT (eligible for recalibration cohort in single large FQHC)
models_evaluated: logistic regression risk model for colonoscopy completion after abnormal FIT

links.outcome: Discrimination (c-statistic) of original model locally versus redeveloped local model
links.effect: Original model c-statistic dropped from 0.66 to 0.61 in the single large FQHC; redeveloped model in the same FQHC reached c-statistic 0.65 (n=1401).
links.quote: The model was redeveloped in the same FQHC in a cohort of 1401 patients with a c-statistic of 0.65.

links.outcome: Performance of externally developed model on local data
links.effect: When applied to a single large FQHC (884 patients), the model did not recalibrate successfully; c-statistic dropped more than 0.05, from 0.66 to 0.61.
links.quote: When we applied the model to a single large FQHC (34 clinics, 884 eligible patients), the model did not recalibrate successfully (c-statistic dropped more than 0.05, from 0.66 to 0.61).
